candidates.name: Mova
candidates.description: Mova is an AI job search tool for professionals who want to avoid spending hours scrolling job boards. Every day, it scans over 30 job boards and company career pages, filters roles that fit your profile and goals, and displays them in one dashboard. For each match, it creates an application strategy showing where your experience aligns with the role, ATS keyword and CV recommendations, and a tailored cover letter in 21 languages. It focuses on fewer, better applications, not auto-apply spam. Early adopters can use it free for 7 days with no card required, or try a live demo without signing up. View startup
